events.name: From Prototype to Production: Ready for Customers (w/ Baseline and The AI Collective)
events.description:
Tools like Lovable have made it possible for a non-technical founder to ship a working prototype in a night. Getting that prototype in front of paying customers, handling their data safely, and keeping it running when something breaks is a different problem.
Karen Forde, founder of Bridge the Gapp,
events.descriptionSummary: Karen Forde, founder of Bridge the Gapp, will break down what happens after you ship that AI-built prototype—covering the real costs of scaling, common pitfalls she spots in founder codebases, and early decisions that keep things production-ready. It's built for non-technical founders wondering what's next after building with AI tools, complete with a live clinic to workshop your own project.

events.name: ThinkingAI Agentic Growth Summit 2026
events.description:
Most teams have deployed AI. Far fewer have changed how the work actually gets done.

events.descriptionSummary: Industry leaders and practitioners will dig into how agentic AI actually reshapes operations when analytics can take action instead of just reporting, with real examples of what's working, what still needs humans, and where teams are seeing measurable returns.
